sections.heading: MAJOR IN GEOGRAPHIC INFORMATION SCIENCE
lines: Faculty of Social Science - Geography and Environment

Completion of first-year requirements, including 1.0 course from Geography and Environment 1100, Geography and Environment 1200A/B, Geography and Environment 1300A/B, Geography and Environment 1400F/G, Geography and Environment 1500F/G, Environmental Science 1021F/G with a mark of at least 60% in each of these courses.

If upper-year students have not completed 1.0 courses listed above, they may select one or two courses from: Geography and Environment 2131A/B, Geography and Environment 2132A/B, Geography and Environment 2133A/B, Geography and Environment 2152F/G, and/or Geography and Environment 2153A/B in making up the 1.0 admission requirement, as long as they were completed with a grade of at least 60%. Senior qualifying entry course(s) cannot be counted for subsequent program credit.
0.5 or 1.0* course from: Geography and Environment 2210A/B or any university-level statistics course at the 2000 level or above* (normally taken in Year 2).
1.0 course: Geography and Environment 2220A/B, Geography and Environment 2230A/B.

1.0 course from: Geography and Environment 2310A/B, Geography and Environment 2320A/B, Geography and Environment 2330A/B, Geography and Environment 2411F/G, Geography and Environment 2412F/G, Geography and Environment 2420A/B, Geography and Environment 2430A/B, Geography and Environment 2460F/G.
1.5 courses: Geography and Environment 3222A/B, Geography and Environment 4210A/B, Geography and Environment 4211A/B, the former Geography 3210A/B, the former Geography 3211A/B.

2.0 courses from: Computer Science 2034A/B, Computer Science 2120A/B, Geography and Environment 3224A/B, Geography and Environment 3225A/B, Geography and Environment 4221A/B, Geography and Environment 4230A/B, the former Geography 3223A/B, the former Geography 3226A/B, the former Geography 3231A/B, the former Geography 3421A/B.
*If a 1.0 course is taken, the module will consist of 6.5 courses.
1. Honours degrees require two Major modules.
2. Combination with a Major module in Science or Basic Medical Sciences may allow graduation with a four-year BSc degree.

3. When taken within this module, the following Geography and Environment courses count towards meeting the requirement of 11.0 Science courses in a 4-Year BSc: Geography and Environment 2210A/B, Geography and Environment 2220A/B, Geography and Environment 2230A/B, Geography and Environment 2310A/B, Geography and Environment 2320A/B, Geography and Environment 2330A/B, Geography and Environment 3222A/B, Geography and Environment 3224A/B, Geography and Environment 4210A/B, Geography and Environment 4211A/B, Geography and Environment 4221A/B, Geography and Environment 4230A/B, Geography and Environment 4901E, the former Geography 3210A/B, the former Geography 3211A/B, the former Geography 3223A/B, the former Geography 3226A/B, the former Geography 3231A/B.
This module may NOT be combined with any Geography and Environment module.
